title: llama.cpp / vLLM / OpenAI-compatible (embeddings)
description: An embedding model on any server that speaks OpenAI's embeddings API (llama.cpp, vLLM, Text Embeddings Inference, LM Studio), on this machine or your network, as gohort's semantic search: the request and the reply are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Start the server with an embedding model (llama.cpp: llama-server --embeddings; vLLM: vllm serve <model> --task embed). The connector takes no key. gohort provides one, named local-embeddings and listed as Local embeddings server; another, for a second server, is added from here. Choose it under Capabilities > Embeddings and give the server's address and the model there; Test there embeds two short sentences. An embedder on this machine or its network waits its turn behind the worker model, as chat does. Many retrieval models want their texts marked (e5: "query: " and "passage: "): set the prefixes under Capabilities > Embeddings. A server that takes a key: declare a secret setting sent as bearer in its spec's config, name it in auth in place of none, and give the key under the choice. Switching embedders changes the embedding space: run Repair in the Vector Index panel to make stored documents searchable again, which embeds every one of them.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the embeddings settings list it by this name.

config.name: base_url
config.label: Server address
config.help: The address its /embeddings is under, usually ending in /v1: http://localhost:8080/v1 for llama.cpp, http://localhost:8000/v1 for vLLM.

config.name: model
config.label: Model
config.help: The name the server loaded the model as (vLLM checks it; llama.cpp takes any). The model names the embedding space: changing it later means re-embedding every stored document.
